findings.evidence: `rg -n "theorem .*coact" code/TauCeti/Algebra/Coalgebra` shows existing public names `regular_coact`, `cofree_coact`, `transport_coact`, and `of_coact`; the naming guide says namespaced definitions used in lemma names should drop the namespace when unambiguous, rather than adding `comodule_`.
findings.fix: Rename it to `quotient_coact` or `quotient_coact_eq_quotientCoact`, matching the existing `regular_coact`, `cofree_coact`, `transport_coact`, and `ComoduleCat.of_coact` pattern.
findings.issue: `quotient_comodule_coact` inserts `comodule` into the theorem name instead of naming the conclusion around `coact`, unlike adjacent TauCeti names for coactions.

summary: One public theorem name uses a nonstandard extra namespace word for `Comodule.coact`; the quotient API otherwise follows the established `mkQ`/`liftQ` quotient naming.
